title: Dragable Cards
desc: Trello-style board for Compose: long-press a card and drag it between columns.
long: A Trello-style board for Jetpack Compose. Long-press a card, drag it between columns, and watch the others slide out of the way as it snaps into place. Bring your own card composable; the board only adds the motion: a lift with tilt and shadow, an empty slot where it will land, a near critically damped drop, auto-scroll at the edges and haptics.
params: The cards of every column. Create it with rememberDragBoardState.
Standard Compose Modifier. Give the board a bounded height.
Padding around the columns, inside the horizontal scroll. Default 16.dp.
The container around each column: background, border, shape, padding.
The lifted card and the empty slot: scale 1.04, tilt 4°, shadow 12.dp, corner radius.
Long-press delay (150 ms) and the lift, shuffle and drop springs.
After a card lands: item, old column, new column and index there.
The empty slot, given the card's height.
Drawn at the top of each column, given its index and cards.
Draws one card. The same composable draws the floating copy while dragging.
